response.justification: The candidate is an experienced and versatile senior engineer, but the profile does not match the core mandatory requirements of this role. Professional C++ exposure is limited to roughly seven months at National Instruments (2014–2015) writing C/C++ components, more than a decade ago, rather than the required 5–10 years of hands-on C++ on Windows. There is no evidence of SQL Server or Oracle work (only generic SQL/MySQL/MongoDB), and no fixed income, derivatives, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience — RIDE Capital is a fintech/investment-platform role built in Node/TypeScript/GraphQL, not a capital-markets engineering environment. Strengths in testing, CI/CD, and communication are genuine but peripheral to the mandatory criteria.
strengths: Broad senior-level engineering experience across backend, low-latency, and distributed systems
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, DevOps tooling, public talks and workshops (good communication signal)
Some fintech/investment-platform exposure at RIDE Capital and systems-level C/C++ background at National Instruments
concerns: Essentially no recent or substantial professional C++ experience; primary stack is TypeScript/Node and DLang
No SQL Server or Oracle experience demonstrated, and no Windows platform development
No fixed income, derivatives, or investment banking / capital markets domain knowledge

key_factors.factor: SQL Server / Oracle and Windows experience
